payload.core_composition_summary: Tree DP computes edge contributions; sorting orders both; greedy assignment maximizes sum using rearrangement inequality and combines excess factors.
payload.rationale: Solution computes subtree sizes via tree traversal (DP), sorts contributions and prime factors, then greedily pairs largest factors with largest contributions after handling excess.
